title: Oil Tanker Freight Costs Exceed SpaceX Rocket Launch Price as Hormuz Crisis Spikes Global Shipping
detail: Oil tanker shipping costs have risen to levels exceeding the cost of launching a SpaceX rocket, underscoring the extreme market impact of the Strait of Hormuz crisis on global freight. The extraordinary freight rate surge reflects persistent maritime security fears following repeated vessel attacks and insurance premium escalation across the Persian Gulf transit corridor.

title: At Least 11 Commercial Ships Attacked in Strait of Hormuz Since Early October
detail: At least 11 commercial ships have been attacked in and around the Strait of Hormuz since the beginning of October, intensifying the maritime security crisis in the world's most critical oil chokepoint. The sustained attack tempo is forcing insurers to sharply raise war-risk premiums and compelling shipping companies to reroute vessels around the Cape of Good Hope, adding weeks and millions of dollars in costs per voyage.

title: WTI Crude Approaches $92/Barrel as Hormuz Crisis Sustains Price Pressure; Russia Offers Diesel to US
detail: WTI crude oil prices approached $92/barrel as the ongoing Strait of Hormuz crisis continued to sustain upward price pressure on global energy markets. The price move was partially offset by Russia's offer to supply diesel to the United States, providing some relief to fuel markets that have been strained since shipping interdictions began affecting Persian Gulf transit routes.
